y-m-64-06.title: Yaya yiwuwar ke canzawa yayin da ake ƙara bayani ɗaya bayan ɗaya?
y-m-64-06.topic: Yiwuwar sharadi: yadda yiwuwar ke canzawa yayin ƙara bayani
y-m-64-06.goal: Ta hanyar ƙidaya yanayi, bi yadda sabon bayani ke rage yanayin da zai yiwu, sannan yiwuwar ta ƙaru, ta tsaya, ko ta zama 1.
y-m-64-06.material: Ana jefa jan zar da shuɗin zar sau ɗaya kowanne. Zar biyu masu adalci ne, ba sa shafar juna, kuma fuskoki 1 zuwa 6 suna da dama iri ɗaya. Jimillar 8 ko fiye ana kiranta “nasara.” Ba a san sakamakon ba tukuna; ana bayyana bayani mataki-mataki.
y-m-64-06.thinking.0: Duba yadda sabon bayani ke canza yanayi masu yiwuwa
y-m-64-06.thinking.1: Bayyana dalilin gyara ko riƙe hukunci
y-m-64-06.thinking.2: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa yiwuwar ba ta canzawa
y-m-64-06.prereq.0: “H1” alamar wahala da matakin taimako ce kawai a wannan aikin samarwa, ba warewar aji ba. An ɗauka ka koyi a Probability and Statistics na sakandare samun yiwuwar ta (yanayin da ya faru) ÷ (dukkan yanayi).
y-m-64-06.prereq.1: Kwarewar jera fuskokin zar biyu a matsayin jeri 36 (fuskar jan zar, fuskar shuɗi)
y-m-64-06.prereq.2: Tunanin “a bar yanayin da ya dace da bayanin kawai”
y-m-64-06.s.s1.prompt: Ana bayyana bayani ɗaya bayan ɗaya. Kowane lokaci zaɓi tunaninka kan girman yiwuwar “nasara.”
y-m-64-06.s.s1.hint.0: Duk lokacin da aka ba da bayani, rubuta yanayi 36 a tebur, soke sel da ba su dace ba, sannan ka ƙidaya ragowar.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ƙidaya ragowar sel masu jimillar 8 ko fiye, rubuta rabonsu, sannan ka kwatanta da rabon matakin baya.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.info: Kafin jefa zar ne. Ba a san fuskokin ba tukuna.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.ask: Kusan nawa ne yiwuwar nasara (jimillar fuskokin biyu aƙalla 8)?
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.after: Jimilloli 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 suna da hanyoyi 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, jimilla hanyoyi 15. Yiwuwar ita ce 15/36=5/12.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Idan ka jera duk hanyoyin jimilla 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, ba hanyoyi 12 ba ne. Duba jimillar da aka rasa hanyoyinta.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan ƙiyasi ya ɗauki jimillar tsakiya 7 a matsayin iyakar rabawa, ya ɗauka rabi da rabi ne. Hanyoyi 6 na jimillar 7 ba nasara ba ne.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan ya yi daidai da ƙidaya da haɗa hanyoyin jimilla 8, 9, 10, 11 da 12.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Wataƙila an ɗauka “8 ko fiye” babban zangon jimilloli 6 ne (7 zuwa 12). Jimilla mafi girma tana da hanyoyi kaɗan.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.info: Wani ɗalibi ya ce kawai “jimillar fuskokin biyun ma’auriya ce.” Har yanzu ba ka san fuskokin ba.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yaya yiwuwar nasara ta canza yanzu?
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yaya yiwuwar nasara ta canza yanzu?
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.after: Jimilloli ma’auriya 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 suna da hanyoyi 1, 3, 5, 5, 3, 1; jimilla 18. Cikinsu, nasarori 8, 10, 12 hanyoyi 9 ne. Yiwuwar 9/18=1/2, ta fi 5/12 girma.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan ya yi daidai da ƙidayar 5+3+1=9 hanyoyin jimilla 8, 10, 12 cikin hanyoyi 18 masu jimilla ma’auriya.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Bayanin cewa jimilla ma’auriya ce ya rage yanayi daga 36 zuwa 18. A sake ƙidaya cikin ragowar.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ta ragu zuwa kusan kashi ɗaya bisa uku
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Idan an bar yanayi masu jimilla ma’auriya kawai, rabon jimilla 8, 10, 12 yana ƙaruwa. Ka ƙidaya ragowar da kanka.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ta ƙaru sosai, zuwa kusan 5/6 ko fiye
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Yanayi ma’auriya sun haɗa jimilloli 2, 4, 6 ma. Yawancin waɗannan ba nasara ba ne.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.info: Ɗalibin ya ƙara cewa: “Jimillar ma’auriya ce, kuma fuskokin zar biyun sun bambanta.”
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Hanyoyin jimilla ma’auriya masu fuskoki daban su ne 18−6=12; nasarori cikinsu 9−3=6. Yiwuwar 6/12=1/2, ba ta canza ba. An cire nasarori 3 (4,4), (5,5), (6,6) tare, don haka rabon ya tsaya.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Idan an cire yanayin fuskoki iri ɗaya, nasarori ma an cire. Ƙidaya nawa aka cire a kowane ɓangare.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka ɗauka fuskoki iri ɗaya suna cikin waɗanda ba nasara ba kawai? Jimillar (4,4), (5,5), (6,6) nawa ce?
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.o.c: An ƙara bayani, don haka dole yiwuwar ta canza
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Sabon bayani ba koyaushe ke canza yiwuwar ba. Ka ƙidaya ragowar sannan ka duba rabon.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya ƙidaya ya tabbatar cewa idan an cire yanayin fuskoki iri ɗaya, ana cire nasarori daidai da rabonsu.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.info: Wannan shi ne bayani na ƙarshe. An ce fuskar jan zar ita ce 6. (Jimilla ma’auriya ce kuma fuskokin sun bambanta.)
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.after: Idan jan zar ya nuna 6 kuma jimillar ma’auriya ce, shuɗin zar 2, 4 ko 6 ne; amma fuskoki dole su bambanta, don haka 6 ya fita, ragowar 2 ko 4 ne. Jimillar 8 ko 10 ce, duka nasara, saboda haka yiwuwar 1 ce. (8)
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.a: Da zarar an ƙayyade jan zar, yiwuwar fuskokin shuɗi ta ragu sosai. Rubuta ragowar yanayi da kanka.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.b: Wannan hukunci ya tabbatar ragowar shuɗi 2 da 4 ne kawai, jimillarsu 8 da 10, duka nasarori.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.c: Ka rubuta ragowar yanayi da kanka ka bincika ko akwai wanda ba nasara ba.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.st.3.r.d: Lissafta jimilloli ɗaya bayan ɗaya ga jan zar 6, jimilla ma’auriya, da shuɗi ba 6 ba.
y-m-64-06.s.s1.reflect: Yiwuwar ta canza 5/12 → 1/2 → 1/2 → 1. Wane bayani ya canza ta, wanne bai canza ba? Me ke faruwa idan bayanin ya rage yanayi kuma nasara da rashin nasara sun ragu da rabo iri ɗaya?
y-m-64-06.s.s2.prompt: A mataki na 3 an ƙara “fuskokin sun bambanta” amma yiwuwar ba ta canza ba. Bayyana dalilin ta amfani da yawan ragowar yanayi.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta yanayi 6 da aka cire a mataki na 3 a tebur, ka ƙidaya masu jimilla aƙalla 8.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta “yawan nasara ÷ duk yanayi” kafin da bayan cirewar, sannan ka kwatanta.
y-m-64-06.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Ko da an cire yanayin fuskoki iri ɗaya, ...
y-m-64-06.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka faɗi cewa cikin yanayi 6 da aka cire masu fuskoki iri ɗaya, nasarori su ne (4,4), (5,5), (6,6)?
y-m-64-06.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana da kalmominka cewa “sabon bayani ba koyaushe ke canza yiwuwar ba”?
y-m-64-06.s.s2.model.0: Cikin yanayi 6 masu fuskoki iri ɗaya, 3 ne masu jimilla aƙalla 8, wato rabinsu. Cikin hanyoyi 18 masu jimilla ma’auriya, nasara 9 ce, rabin. Bayan cire yanayi 6, nasara 6 ce cikin ragowar 12, don haka rabon ya tsaya 1/2. (4,4, 5,5, 6,6)
y-m-64-06.s.s2.model.1: Ko an cire yanayi masu fuska ɗaya, rabon jimillar aƙalla 8 cikin ragowar yana nan rabi (6/12), saboda haka yiwuwar ba ta canza ba. Sabon bayanin ya rage yanayi masu yiwuwa, amma nasara da rashin nasara sun ragu da rabo iri ɗaya.

y-m-64-09.title: Za mu iya ɗaukar adadin nasarori a wannan yanayin a matsayin maimaitattun gwaje-gwaje masu yiwuwar nasara iri ɗaya?
y-m-64-09.topic: Rarrabuwar binomial: yanayin da samfurin ya dace da wanda bai dace ba
y-m-64-09.goal: Yanke hukunci ga kowane yanayi kan sharuddan ɗaukar adadin nasarori a gwaje-gwaje maimaitattu a matsayin binomial, sannan ka tabbatar da lambobi yadda sakamakon lissafi ke canzawa idan sharuddan sun karye.
y-m-64-09.material: Don a ɗauki adadin nasarori yana bin rarrabuwar binomial: (1) adadin gwaje-gwaje ya tabbata, (2) kowace gwaji tana da sakamako biyu, nasara ko rashin nasara, (3) yiwuwar nasara iri ɗaya ce a kowace gwaji, (4) gwaje-gwajen ba sa shafar juna. Muna son bincika waɗannan sharudda huɗu a yanayin da ke ƙasa. Akwati yana da ƙwallaye fari 6 da baƙi 4.
y-m-64-09.thinking.1: Lissafa yiwuwar ta amfani da samfurin
y-m-64-09.thinking.2: Haɗa bambancin ƙimomi da dalilin da ya sa samfurin bai dace ba
y-m-64-09.prereq.0: “H1” a wannan aiki alamar wahala da matakin tallafi ce kawai a tsarin samarwa; ba ya nufin manhajar makaranta ta ware batu ga wani aji. Ana ɗauka cewa ka koyi gwaje-gwaje masu zaman kansu da ma’anar rarrabuwar binomial a sashen yiwuwar lissafi da ƙididdiga na sakandare (adadin nasarori ta maimaita gwaji n sau da yiwuwar nasara iri ɗaya).
y-m-64-09.prereq.1: Gogewar ƙirga hanyoyin zaɓar wasu abubuwa daga cikin abubuwa mabambanta
y-m-64-09.prereq.2: Gogewar bayyana da kalmomi bambancin zaɓe tare da mayarwa da ba tare da mayarwa ba
y-m-64-09.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk yanayin da za a iya ɗaukar “adadin nasarori” a matsayin binomial.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowane zaɓi, bincika sharudda huɗun ɗaya bayan ɗaya ba tare da barin ko ɗaya ba. Musamman duba ko yiwuwar nasara iri ɗaya ce a kowace gwaji.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.hint.1: Ga zaɓin da yiwuwar ke kama da canzawa, rubuta da kanka yadda yiwuwar ke canzawa bayan gwaji ta farko.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.a: Adadin ƙwallaye fari da aka fitar idan ana ɗaukar ƙwallo daga akwatin ɗaya bayan ɗaya, duba launinta, ba a mayar da ita ba, an yi haka sau 5.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.a: Duk lokacin da aka fitar da guda, rabon ƙwallaye fari a akwatin yana canzawa; saboda haka yiwuwar nasara a kowane gwaji ba ta tsayayye ba ce.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.b: Adadin nasarori idan ɗan wasa mai nasara 0.6 ya jefa bugun kyauta sau 10 bisa sharudda iri ɗaya, ana ɗauka sakamakon baya ba ya shafar na gaba.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.b: Wannan ya tabbatar cewa an ambaci sharudda huɗun duka a cikin jimla.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.c: Adadin nasarori idan ɗan wasa ɗaya ya jefa sau 10 bisa ƙa’idar cewa yiwuwar nasarar gaba 0.8 ce idan ya yi nasara a baya, 0.4 kuma idan ya gaza.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.c: Yiwuwar nasarar gwaji tana canzawa bisa sakamakon baya, saboda haka gwaje-gwajen suna shafar juna.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.d: Adadin ƙwallaye fari da aka fitar idan an maimaita sau 5 ɗaukar ƙwallo ɗaya, duba launinta, sannan a mayar da ita cikin akwatin.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ya duba cewa tun da ana mayar da ƙwallon, yanayin akwatin iri ɗaya ne a kowane lokaci.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.o.e: Adadin tambayoyin da aka amsa daidai idan aka yi hasashen bazuwar duk tambayoyin zaɓi huɗu guda 10 (tambayoyin ba sa shafar juna).
y-m-64-09.s.s1.r.e: Wannan ya duba cewa yiwuwar amsa kowace tambaya daidai iri ɗaya ce kuma tambayoyin ba sa shafar juna.
y-m-64-09.s.s1.explain: A b, d, da e, adadin gwaje-gwaje tabbatacce ne, yiwuwar nasara a kowace gwaji tsayayyiya ce, gwaje-gwajen kuma ba sa shafar juna. A a, ba a mayar da ƙwallayen da aka fitar ba, saboda haka yiwuwar tana canzawa; a c kuma sakamakon baya yana canza yiwuwar gaba, don haka gwaje-gwajen suna shafar juna.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.prompt: Kimanin nawa ne yiwuwar ɗan wasan zaɓi b (yiwuwar nasara 0.6) ya yi nasara daidai sau 7 cikin 10?
y-m-64-09.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta yanayi guda mai nasara 7 da rashin nasara 3, ka nemo yiwuwarsa.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.hint.1: Ƙidaya adadin irin waɗannan yanayi (waɗanne 7 ne suka yi nasara), sannan ka ninka yiwuwar yanayi guda da wannan adadi.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.r.a: Wannan yiwuwar yanayi guda ne kawai inda nasarori 7 da rashin nasarori 3 suka zo a takamaiman tsari. Ka manta cewa akwai wurare da dama da za a iya sanya nasarorin 7.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.r.b: Ka ninka yiwuwar nasara sau 7 kawai, ba ka ƙirga sharadin sauran 3 sun gaza ba.

y-m-64-09.s.s2.r.d: Wannan ƙima ce da ta ƙirga hanyoyin zaɓar wuraren 7 da kuma yiwuwar samun nasarori 7 da gazawa 3.
y-m-64-09.s.s2.explain: Hanyoyin zaɓar wuraren nasarori 7 cikin 10 su ne 10C7=120, yiwuwar kowanne kuma 0.6^7 × 0.4^3 ≈ 0.001792; jimillarsu 120 × 0.001792 ≈ 0.215.
y-m-64-09.s.s3.prompt: Ga zaɓi a (fitar da ƙwallo sau 5 ba tare da mayarwa ba), yiwuwar samun ƙwallaye fari 5 duka ta dabarar binomial ita ce 0.6 zuwa ƙarfin 5 ≈ 0.078, amma ainihin lissafi yana ba da 6/252 ≈ 0.024. Bayyana dalilin bambancin ƙimomin biyun, ka haɗa da sharuddan yanayin.
y-m-64-09.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta adadin ƙwallaye fari da jimillar ƙwallaye da ke akwatin bayan ƙwallo fari ta fito a farko.
y-m-64-09.s.s3.hint.1: Nemo yiwuwar ƙwallo fari ta fito a karo na biyu, ka kwatanta da 0.6.

y-m-64-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayar da takamaiman lambobi da ke nuna cewa adadin ƙwallaye fari a akwatin yana raguwa duk lokacin da aka fitar guda ɗaya (misali 6/10 sannan 5/9)?
y-m-64-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana, har da alkiblar canjin, dalilin da ya sa dabarar binomial ta fi ainihin ƙima girma?
y-m-64-09.s.s3.model.0: Tun da ba a mayar da ƙwallayen da aka fitar ba, rabon ƙwallaye fari a akwatin yana canzawa a kowane fitarwa. Na farko 6/10 ne; amma idan ƙwallo fari ta fito, na gaba ya ragu zuwa 5/9, don haka ba zai kasance 0.6 a kowane lokaci ba. y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Ƙimomin da aka daidaita su ne (85−70)÷10=1.5 ga lissafi, da (72−60)÷5=2.4 ga Turanci. Bisa yawan karkacewar ma’auni daga matsakaici, Turanci yana sama. Amma wannan fassara ta dogara da zato, wanda ba a tabbatar ba, cewa rarrabuwar maki tana da siffar kararrawa.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Lissafi: yana da maki 15 sama da matsakaici, fiye da maki 12 na Turanci.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka kwatanta bambancin maki kawai. Yaɗuwar maki a jarrabawar biyun ta bambanta, saboda haka maki 15 da 12 suna nufin abubuwa mabambanta.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Turanci: yana da karkacewar ma’auni 2.4 sama, lissafi kuma 1.5.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan ya kwatanta nisan daga matsakaici a matsayin ninkin karkacewar ma’auni, da (72−60)÷5=2.4 da (85−70)÷10=1.5.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Daidai suke: maki na darussan biyun sun fi matsakaici.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka duba cewa sun fi matsakaici kawai, ba ka kwatanta nisan da suke sama da shi ba.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Da alama Turanci ne, amma siffar kararrawa zato ce, saboda haka hukuncin na ɗan lokaci ne.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wannan ya kwatanta da ƙimomin da aka daidaita amma ya yi la’akari da cewa ba a tabbatar da zato game da siffar rarrabuwar ba.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.2.info: An bayyana bayanan matsayi na ajin. A Turanci, 3 cikin 30 sun samu 72 ko fiye; a lissafi kuma 2 cikin 30 sun samu 85 ko fiye. Mafi yawan maki Turanci sun taru tsakanin 55 da 65, kaɗan ne kawai suka samu maki masu yawa, don haka wutsiyar rarrabuwar ta miƙe zuwa dama.
y-m-64-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan rarrabuwar tana da siffar kararrawa (rarrabuwar al’ada), kaso aƙalla karkacewar ma’auni 2.4 sama da matsakaici kusan 0.8% ne, don haka ya kamata kusan ɗalibai 0.25 cikin 30 su kasance a wurin; amma a Turanci 3 ne, don haka yana da wuya a ɗauke ta a matsayin rarrabuwar al’ada. Ga lissafi, kaso aƙalla 1.5 sama kusan 6.7% ne, wato kusan 2 cikin 30, wanda ya dace da ainihin 2. Bambancin kaɗan ne; za a iya cewa “kusan iri ɗaya”, amma sakamakon kwatancen da aka daidaita cewa Turanci ya fi yawa sosai bai dace da bayanan matsayi ba.
